description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the UserValidator class, located within the org.openmrs.validator package. It tests username validation, retire reason validation, email validation, global property effects, and overall user validation logic within the OpenMRS system, using JUnit 5.

classes.name: UserValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that tests the UserValidator functionalities such as username validation, retire reason validation, email validation, and overall user validation within the OpenMRS core system.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateUsernameWithOnlyAlphaNumerics
methods.description: Tests that the username validation accepts usernames with only alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateUsernameWithAlphaDashAndUnderscore
methods.description: Tests that the username validation accepts usernames with dashes, underscores, and periods.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateUsernameWithAlphaDashUnderscoreAndDot
methods.description: Tests complex usernames with allowed characters for validation.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateUsernameWithExactlyMaxSizeName
methods.description: Ensures that usernames exactly at max length pass validation.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldNotValidateUsernameWithLessThanMinimumLength
methods.description: Ensures usernames shorter than minimum length are rejected.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldNotValidateUsernameWithInvalidCharacter
methods.description: Checks that usernames with invalid characters are rejected.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldNotValidateUsernameWithMoreThanMaximumSize
methods.description: Verifies that usernames exceeding max length are rejected.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredAndRetireReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that retiring a user without a retire reason causes validation error.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredAndRetireReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests validation failure when retire reason is empty string.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredAndRetireReasonIsWhitespace
methods.description: Tests validation failure when retire reason is whitespace.

methods.name: invokeValidateAndAssertHasErrorRetireReason
methods.description: Helper method to check validation errors related to retire reason.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Tests that a user with valid fields passes validation.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateWhenUsernameIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null username is considered valid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldValidateWhenUsernameIsTheEmptyString
methods.description: Checks that empty string username is considered valid.

methods.name: isUserNameValid_shouldNotValidateWhenUsernameIsWhitespaceOnly
methods.description: Checks that whitespace-only username is rejected.

methods.name: isUserNameAsEmailValid_shouldReturnFalseIfEmailInvalid
methods.description: Verifies invalid email formats are rejected.

methods.name: isUserNameAsEmailValid_shouldReturnTrueIfEmailValid
methods.description: Verifies valid email formats are accepted.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEmailAsUsernameEnabledAndEmailInvalid
methods.description: Tests validation failure when email-as-username is enabled but email is invalid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEmailAsUsernameDisabledAndEmailProvided

methods.name: validate_shouldNotThrowNPEWhenUserIsNull

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfEmailIsInvalid
methods.description: Ensures invalid email field triggers validation error.

methods.description: Checks that valid email fields pass validation.
